t: Reviving Pipulate for the LLM Era: Python, HTMX, and SEO Workflows
s: Pipulate is being re-architected as a Python-based web framework utilizing HTMX to simplify linear SEO workflows, moving away from complex Jupyter Notebook interfaces for both developers and end-users. It aims to package SEO tasks into distributable, locally runnable web apps.
sub: Packaging SEO tasks into Pythonic linear workflows.
Leveraging HTMX to reduce client-side JavaScript dependency in Python web apps.
Transforming Jupyter Notebooks into user-friendly, distributable web applications.
The resurgence of 'software wizard' patterns for guided user experiences.
